text.p: These are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Alfred Sant and opposition leader Eddie Fenech Adami end year in controversy, attacking each other over opposition nominations to the boards of government companies.
- Filipino sailor Evelito Ruelo found dead on board the M.V. Libertas at Malta Drydocks. No foul play suspected.
- Naxxar local council objects to waste separation plant for environmental reasons.

- Labour Party attacks local council for banning development of a Labour-owned property at Pembroke, six miles north of Valletta. The property has been listed as historic site on insistance by the council but Labour wants to develop it as a commercial complex.
